body:
Skills call each other (orchestrator dispatches step skills, provider/utility skills share contracts, e.g. spec list and spec index skills overlap). Editing one skill contract (inputs, outputs, scripts, file conventions) without checking its dependents leaves the harness inconsistent.

Proposal: add a project AGENTS.md authoring rule requiring that when fixing, updating, or editing a skill, the agent consult the skill dependency graph (skill-dependencies manifest / package membership) to identify callers and callees, verify their contracts still hold against the change, and update them in the same change or record explicit follow-ups. Regenerate integrity data and run the harness checks with the whole affected set.

Example: changing the spec-list skill should trigger a check of the spec-index skill for needed matching updates.

Acceptance: rule present in AGENTS.md authoring guidance; dependency manifest consulted on every skill edit; related skills updated atomically or tracked as follow-ups.
title: Add AGENTS.md rule: check the skill dependency graph when editing a skill so callers and callees stay in sync
